reviews.author: Anna Kmieciak (Anna K)
reviews.text:
I needed a place to repair my broken screen. This place was the nearest to where I was staying, so I decided to go and see, if anything can be done before my flight later that day
The atmosphere, the kindness and communication was more than 5* Not only my phone was fixed, but it was friendly and not overpriced. I recommend the place and if I need anything I will definitely be back. Top service. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

reviews.author: Francisco J. Martin Navarro
reviews.text: I visited this new shop in my local area to check out what they have and I was blown away. They have everything you could possibly need for mobile phones, computers, laptops, tablets, and repairs. I only went to browse and ended up buying five things. The service is excellent—super polite, courteous, and attentive, very friendly, and they really inspire confidence. We needed a specialist shop in Bermondsey and we finally have one. I'm sure I'll find everything I could possibly need in electronics here, and they also help, inform, and guide you. I give them a 10 out of 10... thanks guys!
